name: McMarket
description: McMarket is a large-scale multilingual benchmark for cross-market product-based question answering, focusing on leveraging information from auxiliary marketplaces to answer product-related questions in a main marketplace. It includes over 7 million questions from 17 marketplaces across 11 languages and covers two subtasks: review-based answer generation and product-related question ranking.
reputation: A large multilingual benchmark for cross-market product QA that is useful for multilingual retrieval, ranking, and answer generation research.
notes: Includes automatic translation and human assessment of annotations; focuses on cross-market and multilingual scenarios.
